name: Lottie Web
role: Plays frame-addressable Lottie JSON animations in the browser
summary: Airbnb's browser player for Lottie JSON exported by compatible authoring tools. Renders to SVG, canvas or HTML and can be paused and set to an exact frame with goToAndStop, so playback is addressable by time for capture. It plays authored assets; it does not author or edit them. Strength: reuse of vector animation with no re-implementation.
use_when: A designer or marketplace supplies a Lottie JSON that must appear in a scene
Over Rive when the source is Lottie JSON, not a Rive file
Vector icon and character loops that must be frame-seeked for capture
avoid_when: Authoring new motion in code: Anime.js or Anime.js
Smaller runtime for .lottie bundles: dotLottie player
notes: 2026-10-26: official_url is the GitHub repo; docs live in the repo README and wiki. Not run; frame-exact seek claim is from API docs.

assessment.rationale: Last npm release 5.13.0 on 2025-05-21, last push 2025-09-01; MIT, not archived. Still a well-established browser player for frame-addressable Lottie assets.

evidence.result: Owned rectangle sought at frames 0/15/30; expected SVG bounds and red fill matched, and screenshot hashes matched under sequential and shuffled seek using Chromium 156.0.8078.4 / Playwright 1.64.1.
evidence.scope: SVG rectangle goToAndStop at frames 0/15/30; geometry and browser frames repeat in shuffled order. No other Lottie features/assets covered.
